A foreign government arranged the Bali bombings as a covert operation. The executed men were not the perpetrators; they were framed to support an official story. Jemaah Islamiyah responsibility was a cover for the government attack.

The bombings were an intelligence operation designed to be blamed on local militants. A government-directed team performed the attacks, and the prosecution selected innocent men to stand in for that team. Jemaah Islamiyah did not carry out the operation described in the official account. The executions therefore punished scapegoats, while the foreign organizers remained concealed. Responsibility lies with the state actors who planned and conducted the covert attack, not the men convicted in Indonesia.
